label: git-tree-staged-prose-verified
command:
import json,pathlib,re,subprocess,hashlib
report=json.loads(pathlib.Path("/private/tmp/localos-tree-staged-scan-20260921.JWYzSU/redacted.json").read_text())
diff=subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/git","diff","--cached","--binary"],capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
assert hashlib.sha256(diff).hexdigest()=="977964e2c5db8185f984781ffc96ceb1b40dbedf7e778e3e75c0d09fbb8ff6f6"
expected=["".join(["retains","10","Docs"]),"/".join(["expiry","revocation"])]
contexts=["Tree sidecar proves31non-secret values,","No URI/key request,"]
rows=[]
for i,f in enumerate(report):
 assert f["Secret"]=="REDACTED"
 line=diff.decode().splitlines()[f["StartLine"]-1]; p=f["Match"].split("REDACTED")
 vals=set(m.group(1) for m in re.finditer(re.escape(p[0])+r"(.+?)"+re.escape(p[1]),line))
 assert vals=={expected[i]} and contexts[i] in line
 rows.append({"id":i+1,"classification":"NON_SECRET_AUTHORED_PROSE","exact_fixed_phrase_verified":True,"context_verified":True,"diff_line":f["StartLine"]})
print(json.dumps({"rows":rows,"staged_diff_sha256":hashlib.sha256(diff).hexdigest(),"values_withheld":True},indent=2))
